anchor.semantic_hook: A lecture is visibly made by assembling a lectern, microphone, projector lens, and blank presentation panels into one physical object.
anchor.setting: A university conference workshop opens directly onto a tiered auditorium, with a workbench, tool rack, plain lectern, projector, and blank screen. At the center stands one enormous half-built lecture machine assembled from microphone parts, projector lenses, and hinged presentation panels. Everything else in the workshop is ordinary and unmarked.
anchor.absurd_element: an enormous half-built lecture machine assembled from presentation equipment
